verdict.rationale: Render's official MCP server lets users manage infrastructure in natural language from AI apps like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Its tools include deploy triggering, and it supports OAuth sign-in. Render also documents agent workflows such as inspecting metrics and changing service plans after approval, plus 20+ official agent skills for deploying, debugging, monitoring and scaling. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside Render itself (all natural-language control runs through third-party AI clients), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works well in practice.
